the active path does not prove the value is non-null

silence_invariants: a dominating non-null check or successful initializer proves the value is safe

transfer_axes: equivalent nullability guards before sibling dereference sites

equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths
equivalent local state transitions around the same sink or dereference
equivalent ownership or release/reinit lifecycle on the same symbolic resource

broaden into unrelated bug families just to improve hit count
report every pointer dereference regardless of path proof
confuse null checks with unrelated branch conditions
placeholder helper logic or empty ProgramState modeling

Stay silent on patched code when patch-added guards, barriers, or safe APIs prove the mechanism is blocked.
Generalize along semantic slices and call-chain evidence rather than patch-local syntax.
Preserve valid analyzer-facing syntax and interfaces while keeping semantics unchanged.

constraints.title: Generalize beyond patch site
constraints.description: Do not bind the detector to fixed file paths, line numbers, or exact patch strings.

constraints.title: Preserve vulnerability semantics
constraints.description: Keep the detector focused on the vulnerability family implied by the patch and evidence.

constraints.title: Respect analyzer-native form
constraints.description: Output must be a valid checker_plugin for csa.

constraints.title: Stay within proven mechanism scope
constraints.description: Generalize only along evidence-supported semantic dimensions. Do not broaden the detector into unrelated globals, APIs, or bug families.

constraints.title: Honor mechanism contract
constraints.description: Preserve the mechanism family `nullability_contract_violation` by keeping trigger invariants a pointer-like value reaches dereference, field access, or indirect call; the active path does not prove the value is non-null; Patch-backed trigger clue: added guard: if (!vc).

constraints.title: Generalize only on contract axes
constraints.description: Reuse semantics only along these transfer axes: equivalent nullability guards before sibling dereference sites; equivalent initialization or validation patterns for the same pointer role; equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths.

constraints.title: Encode the patch-added barrier
constraints.description: treat guards such as if (!vc) as semantic barriers.

constraints.title: Respect patched silence
constraints.description: Use these no-report conditions when they are semantically proven: length/capacity guard present: if (!vc).

constraints.title: Require missing non-null proof
constraints.description: Only report dereference-like sinks when the active path lacks a non-null proof; patched null checks and early returns must stay silent.

constraints.title: Use path-sensitive evidence
constraints.description: Prefer guards, state transitions, and lifecycle facts over broad textual matching.

constraints.title: No placeholder helper logic
constraints.description: Helper predicates must inspect AST/program state and must not be unconditional return-true/return-false stubs.
